Fixture asked a single-directory private helper to create missing parents. Changed it to ordered private parent creation, preserving the production filesystem rules.

Native commit and fresh Service recovery had succeeded, then test policy-store setup used a missing state directory/key. Initialized the existing private test policy store before SDK/data creation; no authority requirement was relaxed.

Fixed production lease setup to create only its existing context-assistance/jobs lock path; all six unchanged assertions now pass. Explicit enrollment now shares that lifecycle lock.
New disabled-recovery variant had a large inline pointer. Boxed that metadata value; strict all-target release Clippy passes without suppression.
